Accessible Student Workflow Prototype

Deadline: 15 August 2026

The team must identify an accessibility barrier affecting students who use digital
group-work tools. Research existing approaches and compare their strengths and
limitations.

Required deliverables:
- Build a working web application prototype demonstrating an accessible central workflow.
- Test keyboard navigation and document expected and actual results.
- Submit source code in a GitHub repository with setup instructions.
- Prepare a concise final presentation explaining the problem, evidence, solution, and test result.

The repository must not contain secrets. The final demonstration should show how
accepted work is passed to the next dependent task.
